<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022025-05-0511-33-00" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">gnyal pa</rs> na re | dgos med kyi bstan bcos la | 'dod bya ma yin pa dang 'brel med dgos pa la | bsgrub mi nus gang zag bstan bcos brjod bya gsum ka la 'gog zer ba la | phyi ma gnyis mi 'thad de | de 'gog gi
        <lb n="12a4"/> ngag gnyis chos can dgag mi nus par thal | bstan bcos 'dis dgos pa de bsgrub mi nus sam | dgos pa 'di bstan bcos 'di dang ma 'brel lam zhes gnyis ka la zhugs pa la | khyed bsgrub mi nus gang zag bstan bcos brjod bya gsum ka la 'gog cing 'brel med kyi log rtogs
        <lb n="12a5"/> dgos pa nyid kyi steng du 'gog pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_089_02 legs spyad nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha'i rgyal po.xml
